reader.title: Subexponential bound in the common part size under ETH

bounds.statement: Under ETH, no deterministic algorithm solves Three-Dimensional Matching within the stated running time.

sourceBasis.step: The reduction gives q=6M for a formula with M clauses. The set of distinct triples has size at most q³, so the displayed polynomial factor can be absorbed into the exponent.

encoding: Three disjoint sets X, Y and Z each of size q, and an explicit set T of triples in X × Y × Z.
parameter: The number of elements in each of the three sets q.

reader.parameter: The number of elements in each of the three sets q.

parameterSymbols.meaning: number of elements in each of the three sets

task: Are there q triples in T that together use every element of X, Y and Z exactly once?
